import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                c=colors.get(bmi, '#3498db'), label=bmi, s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
disorder_colors = {'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'], 
                c=disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#9b59b6'), label=disorder, s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Stress Level and Heart Rate by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_data = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({'Stress Level': 'mean', 'Heart Rate': 'mean'}).reset_index()
x = range(len(occupation_data))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], occupation_data['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
bars2 = ax3_twin.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], occupation_data['Heart Rate'], width, label='Heart Rate', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, color='#e74c3c')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, color='#3498db')
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(occupation_data['Occupation'], rotation=15, ha='right')
ax3.set_title('Stress Level & Heart Rate by Occupation', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(loc='upper left')
ax3_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: BMI Category Distribution with Sleep Disorder breakdown
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
pivot_data = df.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
